headword: {阿吽|あうん}の{呼吸|こきゅう}

definitions.gloss: perfect synchronization; tacit understanding; unspoken coordination
definitions.explanation: The ability of two people to act in perfect harmony without needing verbal communication. Implies a deep, intuitive mutual understanding built through long experience together.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}は{阿吽|あうん}の{呼吸|こきゅう}だ。
examples.english: Those two are in perfect sync.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{夫婦|ふうふ}ならではの{阿吽|あうん}の{呼吸|こきゅう}で{動|うご}く。
examples.english: They move with the unspoken coordination that only comes from years of marriage.

examples.japanese: {漫才|まんざい}コンビが{阿吽|あうん}の{呼吸|こきゅう}でボケとツッコミを{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた。
examples.english: The comedy duo performed their boke and tsukkomi routine in perfect synchronization.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From Buddhist terminology. {阿|あ} (a) and {吽|うん} (un) represent the first and last sounds of the Sanskrit alphabet, symbolizing the beginning and end of all things. The {阿|あ} figure at a temple has an open mouth and the {吽|うん} figure has a closed mouth, representing perfect complementarity.

USAGE:
Used to praise the seamless cooperation between partners, teammates, or long-time colleagues. Implies that communication happens at an intuitive level beyond words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {阿吽|あうん}の{呼吸|こきゅう}で{動|うご}く (to move in perfect sync)
- {阿吽|あうん}の{呼吸|こきゅう}が{合|あ}う (to be in sync)
